Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request (audit period clarification & delivery)

Hi Karthik,

We're starting our vendor assurance process for Nimbus Health's 2027 vendor review. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide: the most recent SOC 2 Type II report covering the period May 1, 2025 - Apr 30, 2026, and an accompanying bridge letter (if the report doesn't cover the current date)? Our procurement team also needs guidance on the minimal artifact set you can share (control snapshots, log samples, policy index) and secure transfer options.

Timeline: procurement would like to receive materials by next Friday, 24 Dec, if possible. If that's not feasible, please let us know a realistic ETA.

Cc'ing Alex (IT compliance) for any technical questions.

Thanks,
Emma Liu
Head of Information Security
Nimbus Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 11:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request (audit period clarification & delivery)

Hi Emma — thanks for the note and the timeline. We can absolutely support Nimbus' vendor review. Quick summary of next steps and options so procurement/IT can pick a path: 

1) What we can provide now
- SOC 2 Type II report for period 2025-05-01 to 2026-04-30 (final PDF).
- Draft bridge letter (PDF) outlining that controls remained materially unchanged since the report period; we provide a signed bridge at customer request.
- Evidence manifest (CSV template) listing the types of artifacts we typically share (policy snapshots, sample logs, config screenshots, access reviews).

2) Minimal artifact set (low-friction option)
- Policies: InfoSec policy index (PDF)
- Sample telemetry: 2 x 24-hour log extracts (redacted)
- Access control sample: last quarterly user access review (screenshot or exported CSV)
- Change management sample: 2 representative change tickets (redacted)

3) Secure transfer options (choose one)
- Pre-signed S3 buckets with AES-256 encryption (preferred for bulk bundles)
- SFTP (long-term partner endpoint)
- Encrypted Share link (Box/Drive) with password provided out-of-band

4) Timeline and delivery
- We can deliver the SOC 2 PDF + draft bridge letter within 48 business hours (target: by end of Monday, 21 Dec) assuming approvals from our compliance team.
- Evidence bundle (minimal set) typically takes 3 business days once you confirm the transfer mechanism and sign the evidence-sharing agreement (I can send a one-click DocuSign link).

Attachments I'm including in this email thread to speed things up:
- evidence_manifest_template.csv (fill in which artifacts you'd like)
- secure_transfer_instructions.txt (what to expect for each transfer method)
- SOC2_TypeII_Bridge_Letter_DRAFT.pdf (placeholder; final signed copy provided after confirmation)

If you'd like a single checklist email that procurement can forward to the responsible Nimbus owners, I can drop a compact version. Otherwise, if you confirm SFTP or pre-signed S3 and which artifacts you want, we'll queue the export.

One-line reply templates below for your IT team (copy/paste if helpful):
- "Confirming pre-signed S3 and we request: policies + log samples + access review"
- "We prefer SFTP; please send evidence-sharing agreement for signatures"

Thanks — looping Naomi (compliance lead) and Marissa (security ops) for the evidence pull.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (510) 555-0199

(Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Bridge_Letter_DRAFT.pdf; evidence_manifest_template.csv; secure_transfer_instructions.txt)
